FROMGIT: kvm: fix kvm_ioctl_create_device() reference counting (CVE-2019-6974) commit cfa39381173d5f969daf43582c95ad679189cbc9 upstream. kvm_ioctl_create_device() does the following: 1. creates a device that holds a reference to the VM object (with a borrowed reference, the VM's refcount has not been bumped yet) 2. initializes the device 3. transfers the reference to the device to the caller's file descriptor table 4. calls kvm_get_kvm() to turn the borrowed reference to the VM into a real reference The ownership transfer in step 3 must not happen before the reference to the VM becomes a proper, non-borrowed reference, which only happens in step 4. After step 3, an attacker can close the file descriptor and drop the borrowed reference, which can cause the refcount of the kvm object to drop to zero. This means that we need to grab a reference for the device before anon_inode_getfd(), otherwise the VM can disappear from under us. Fixes: 852b6d57dc7f ("kvm: add device control API") Cc: stable@kernel.org Signed-off-by: Jann Horn <jannh@google.com> Signed-off-by: Paolo Bonzini <pbonzini@redhat.com> Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org> (cherry picked from commit 673f9cf4a99f80a8cab2b015adf1b03c8ca4d66a git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/stable/linux-stable.git linux-3.18.y) BUG=chromium:956415 TEST=None Change-Id: I74e261efad71f28ec2ccd6de81a44748bd580b67 Signed-off-by: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1584580 Reviewed-by: Sean Paul <seanpaul@chromium.org>

common-mk: update psutil.Process().children call Per [0], the psutil API changed in version 2.0.0, to deprecate "get_" from accessors, and in 3.0.0 these deprecated APIs were removed. [0] https://github.com/giampaolo/psutil/blob/master/HISTORY.rst Current version in Chrome OS tree is 2.2.1, which supports both APIs. In platform2_test.py, we still use the old one: "leaked_children = psutil.Process().get_children(recursive=True)" This will break when updating psutil >= 3.0.0. Easy fix is to update the call site to use ".children" which is already supported in current version. Signed-off-by: Daniel Kurtz <djkurtz@chromium.org> BUG=chromium:926296 TEST=FEATURES=test emerge-hana quipper => passes with both psutil-2.2.1 and psutil-5.5.0.
